parties: <cite index="3-3">Ascent Growth Trust and Vintage Classic Limited (consortium) acquiring majority stake from Strides Pharma Science Limited in Pivot Path Private Limited</cite>
headline: <cite index="3-2">Strides Pharma Science Ltd announced divestment of majority stake in its wholly-owned arm Pivot Path for Rs 100 crore to a consortium of investors led by Ascent Capital, along with co-investor Vintage</cite>
sum: Ascent Growth Trust and Vintage Classic acquired a majority stake in Pivot Path (formerly within Strides Pharma) through share purchase of ₹100 crore plus ₹50 crore primary infusion, valuing the life sciences platform at ₹230 crore post-money. Pivot Path was separated into an independent entity under a Scheme of Arrangement approved by the National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT) in May 2026.
implication: <cite index="2-1,2-2">Post-transaction shareholding: Strides 19.95%, investor consortium 65.05%, ESOP pool 15%, with Pivot Path reclassified as an associate company instead of a wholly-owned subsidiary</cite>-a key structuring mechanism allowing the parent to monetize without full exit while retaining upside participation and maintaining operational visibility as an associate.
detail: <cite index="3-5">Strides will receive ₹75 crore at initial closing and ₹25 crore on the first anniversary of closing</cite>. <cite index="45-3,45-4">Pivot Path provides consulting, regulatory compliance, digital transformation and technology-enabled services to pharmaceutical and life sciences companies; for FY26 it reported revenue of ₹144.7 crore and EBITDA of ₹16.9 crore, including revenue generated from services provided to Strides</cite>. <cite index="4-5">Pivot Path received a ₹50 crore primary capital infusion to fund expansion and investments in technology, including AI-led platforms</cite>. <cite index="45-6">The valuation was based on an independent assessment carried out by a Securities and Exchange Board of India (Sebi)-registered merchant banker</cite>.
